explicit_simultaneous_ample_interior.ampleness_reason: D506 is ample and H is nef, hence every B_k is ample; the complete curve degrees are replayed explicitly for B_7
explicit_simultaneous_ample_interior.family: B_k = D506 + kH for nonnegative integral k

explicit_weyl_transport.deterministic_rule: fire the most negative A_i pairing, breaking ties by the smallest one-based curve label

scope.minimality: k=7 is minimal only in the chosen family D506+kH for integral k>=0
scope.minus_four: the five (-4,div2) vectors remain divisor reflections without effectivity or irreducible-curve claims
scope.not_full_nef: the imported 31-wall chamber is not asserted to equal the K3 nef chamber; five mirrors have square -4 and the complete K3 nef chamber has 15 curve walls
scope.positive_gain: the known finite-volume H13/31 chamber now has an explicit ample-interior equation-level K3 realization and a complete effectivity/irreducibility decision for all (-2) mirrors

signed_marking.chosen_marking: negative of the geometric fiber-basis bridge

sources.primary_reference: Xavier Roulleau, An atlas of K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group, EPIGA 6 (2022), article 19

theorem: After the necessary signed marking and a 235-reflection Weyl transport, the equation-level A18-C06 H13/31 carrier meets Roulleau's closed nef chamber on NS=U+E8(-1)+D4(-1).  Its 26 square-minus-two mirrors are effective: exactly five are published irreducible curves and 21 are explicit reducible divisors.  The primitive ample class D506+7H has square 90666 and is strict on all 31 imported walls; seven is minimal in this integral family.
